logp.method_description: Iridium(III) porphyrin complexes (40 μM) in 500 μL n-octanol (saturated with sodium chloride) was mixed with equal volume of aqueous sodium chloride solution (0.9%,w/v). The mixture was shaken for 24 h at 298 K to allow partitioning. The sample was then centrifuged at 5000 rpm for 10 min to separate two different layers carefully. The samples in each phase were digested in conc. HNO3 (9:1, v/v) at 70 °C for 18 h. The amount of iridium (μg/L) in two different phases was determined by ICP-MS analysis.The Log P was determined as the logarithmic ratio of the concentration of iridium in the n-octanol and aqueous phases.
